title: qa(checklist): 18.2.0 sweep ledger edits — i18n, search, studio-authoring, ux-conventions, RUNNER
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9YMBrR5rVpt7qn3c2Z88yrb)_
Fixes #25842
Fixes #25847
Fixes #25848
Part of #25849 (4 of its 5 findings; the write-feedback acceptance[1] reading waits on a maintainer ruling, so the card stays open)
Fixes #25850
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Checklist-accuracy findings from the 18.2.0 release sweep, applied to five ledger files, one commit per card. Wave anchor: #25807 (it stays open; this PR only links it). Docs only: nothing under `packages/`, `ui/` or any governed surface moves, so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.

Every JSON edit revises the item text, bumps its `revision`, and appends a `history` row that names the run record the finding came from (QA runs #25815 `release-18.2.0-tier1` and #25817 `release-18.2.0-manual-set`, both at `6679644a`; #25812 and #25823 for RUNNER). Each finding was re-read against `origin/main` at `cc378e93` first, with objectui paths read under `ui/`.

## Per card

**#25842, `areas/i18n.json` (9 findings, all applied, 5 items).**
- `i18n.flow-copy-translation-and-host-override`: the ref adds the three `packages/cli/test/i18n-flow-*-coverage` tests; the verify for the extract clause says they prove `extractTranslations`, not the command's file write; the validate clause says `translation.test.ts` pins the rule and its remedy while the exit code stays the run's.
- `i18n.surface-matrix`: the ref says the two objectui pins cover the confirm copy and the successMessage handed to the toast, under stubbed action, confirm and toast handlers (no round-trip), so the network clause stays the run's. It also says acceptance 6, 7 and 9 have no pin: the anonymous-deny dogfood's member 200 control asserts none of the locale set, the group vocabulary or the zz-ZZ shape.
- `i18n.strict-translation-key-rejection`: the steps name a snake_case item (the conventional name `zh-CN` is refused first with 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`), and the clause scores 422 `INVALID_METADATA`. A3 cites ADR-0049 and spec 17.0.0, as the live text does. A5 reads the singular label on the record-page badge and the New dialog, and `pluralLabel` on the list header and nav.
- `i18n.notification-localized-and-clears`: the steps and the clause read the server's `unreadCount` (GET /api/v1/notifications), never the header badge, which also counts pending approvals.

**#25847, `areas/search.json` (6 findings, all applied, 4 items).**
- `search.cross-field-object-search`: the pin proves the name-hit control by substring, not by naming Acme Retail.
- `search.field-scoped-narrowing`: the ref is scoped to acceptance 0. The pin has no `$searchFields` refusal case and drives only the POST spelling, so acceptance 1 to 3 and both negatives are the run's. The route-handler INVALID_FIELD evidence in `packages/rest` is named as corroboration.
- `search.global-search-skips-unreadable`: the dogfood pin runs on planted `skipsearch_*` objects, not the showcase objects, and its unscoped case asserts no `totalObjects`.
- `search.pinyin-flag-both-sides`: the run's own paths must not spell `pinyin` (they polluted the zero-hit grep), and the 6679644a counts are recorded (53 on, 52 off).

**#25848, `areas/studio-authoring.json` (9 findings, all applied).** Each `automated.ref` now says which clauses its pins score: jsdom and unit pins that stop above HTTP score only the test-oracle clause. Affected items are `expression-editors`, `meta-save-preconditions-and-draft-rows`, `metadata-diagnostics-sweep` (its pin's `[#8924]` describe is named as protocol-layer evidence for acceptance 3 and negative 0), `object-designer-roundtrip` (F4 is corroboration under a different fixture), `org-override-registry-gate` and `save-door-runs-authoring-rules`. In `permission-matrix-editor-ux`, the ref adds `PermissionMatrixEditor.artifactTier.test.tsx` for the artifact gate. In `record-page-roundtrip`, the ref names the run's objectui pin `b41ed7f68956` beside `cf153eb2e535`.

**#25849, `areas/ux-conventions.json` (5 findings: 4 applied, 1 answered).** `write-feedback`:
- Import Undo works in create and update modes, so the Undo clause is scored on the import instead of `blocked(fixture)`.
- Discard draft is an in-app dialog.
- The approvals route has no drawer: a request opens on its record page.
- The member's refusal row is Mark Done, because the console offers a member no inline edit, selection or drag.
- **Not applied:** the run asks for a ruling on object-only success strings ("Task created successfully", "Settings saved", `Flow "Reassign Task" completed`) under acceptance 1. That is a maintainer decision, so the clause is unchanged and the question is raised in the report on #25842.

**#25850, `RUNNER.md` (3 findings, all applied; re-read on top of #26052).**
- Walled boot: `examples/app-showcase/package.json` declares `@objectstack/organizations`, so a walled run boots from the tree with three variables and no scratch copy.
- Playwright: `/opt/pw-browsers` holds chromium 1243, matching playwright-core 1.63.0, and the alias resolves there (re-read in this container at `cc378e93`). The entry now describes a mismatch as the case to check for.
- `OS_PORT`: `os dev` serves the prebuilt `dist/objectstack.json`, so the connector metadata's `baseUrl` can carry the build-time value while the live dispatch reaches the exported port. The Check now reads the self-ping flow's run.
- Walled personas: after #25626, Create User joins the operator's current organization, so the operator creates an organization and runs `set-active` before minting personas.

**Retired objectui-pin wording in the same files** (#26035 left the area JSON to these cards). `.objectui-sha`, `objectui:refresh` and "not runnable from this checkout" are rewritten to `ui/` paths and `pnpm console:build`. That covers `i18n.studio-follows-app-locale`, `studio-authoring.first-run-loop`, `packaged-automation-studio-lock`, `packaged-display-class-direct-edit`, `doc-on-app-menu`, `picklist-bound-select`, the four "AUTOMATION IS PINNED IN THE objectui REPO" knownGaps in `studio-authoring.json`, and RUNNER's objectui-ref standing fact. Re-scan of the five files' non-history text for `objectui:(build|refresh|bump|clean)`, `build-console.sh`, `.objectui-sha`, `objectui checkout` and "PINNED IN THE objectui REPO": 0 hits. History rows are records and are left as written.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same stale knownGap in other files, out of scope here.** 15 items in `records-forms.json` (12), `automation.json` (2) and `attachments-storage.json` (1) still say their objectui pins are not runnable from this checkout. RUNNER's rewritten fact now tells a runner to read that wording as stale. The items themselves belong to their files' cards, and the report on #25842 names this for the seat.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/search-conformance.ledger.ts` names `showcase-search.dogfood.test.ts` as the proof for `search-fields-override` (400 INVALID_FIELD), but that file has no refusal case. Noted, not filed.
- `examples/app-showcase/src/system/self-url.ts`'s header still says the `os dev` value follows the live environment; at `6679644a` the served metadata did not. This goes to the seat with the OS_PORT finding.

## Verification

At head `bc394208`:
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist`: exit 0, "OK — 16 areas, 329 items".
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 13 families. All 13 ran with exit 0: `check:doc-formula-expressions` refused with exit 3 until `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` were built, then passed.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 13 derived, 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: 5 commits, no card relation, no model identifier.
